description: Use the plan's one included revision. This cannot be undone and uses up that revision, so call shoot_plan_revision_preview first and confirm with the person. For structured plans, change filming time or transfer time (constraintUpdates.availableMinutes, locationTransferMinutes), framing, or structuredChanges. Use the full taskId from shoot_plan_list (not planId). A unique eight-character task prefix or orderReference also works. Connections see only their own live or owner-test plans.

structuredChanges.description: Structured plans only: typed changes that stay within the plan's scope.

repeatable.description: Whether this key moment can be filmed again. A one-time live moment cannot be switched to repeatable.

name: shoot_plan_revise
title: Use the included revision
